name: robots/uuvsimulator__uuv_simulator
title: UUV Simulator underwater current environment
intro: UUV Simulator underwater current environment, adapted from uuvsimulator/uuv_simulator. It reads `flow_velocity` and `read_current_velocity`; runs `set_current_velocity`, `set_horizontal_angle`, `set_vertical_angle` and `zero_current`. `set_current_velocity`: set the simulated current velocity and direction model means. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
